shared_elements: frontal human figure occupying the whole field
human head with face (eyes, nose, mouth) at top
vertical, symmetrical composition centred on a single figure
justification: Both depict a single frontal-facing anthropomorphic figure with the head at the top of a vertical, roughly symmetrical field, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural art offers. A is a densely elaborated personage laden with headdress, ornaments, pendants and outspread feather-like or winged panels, rendered with crisp incised outline and internal detailing, whereas B is a bare, blocky, undetailed figure with only a schematic face and vague arms crossed at the chest — no shared attributes, ornaments, or specific pose.
